files.name: solution.py
files.description: Self-contained Python algorithm. Invoked as `python solution.py <input_path> <output_path>`. Reads the case instance JSON from sys.argv[1]; writes the assignment result JSON to sys.argv[2]. The evaluator finds this file at Path(submission_dir) / 'solution.py' (PLAN_FILE constant, line 1035).

program_output.note: Written by solution.py to the path given by sys.argv[2]; never submitted directly.

root_keys.name: assignments
root_keys.note: Must be the SOLE top-level key in the JSON object (set(document) != {'assignments'} raises error). Must be a non-empty list.

fields.name: cntrGkey
fields.note: Container ID (gkey); must exist in the instance's cntr_info_by_gkey. Identifies which container is being placed. No extractor remapping — values come directly from the input dataset and are validated against it.

fields.name: projectionGkey
fields.note: Slot (projection) ID (gkey); must exist in the instance's slot_info_by_gkey. This is the stowage assignment answer: which vessel slot this container is placed into. Changing this value changes the agent's answer.

structural_checks: solution.py must be present in submission_dir (line 1055-1057: program.is_file() check)
program output must be valid JSON and a dict (line 819-820)
output dict must have exactly one key: 'assignments' — no more, no fewer (line 823: set(document) != {'assignments'})
assignments must be a non-empty list (line 825: not isinstance(assignments, list) or not assignments)
each element must be a list of exactly 2 items (line 832: not isinstance(pair, list) or len(pair) != 2)
both items in each pair must be integers or integer-castable (line 835-837: _as_int check)
cntrGkey must exist in the case's cntr_info_by_gkey (line 839)
projectionGkey must exist in the case's slot_info_by_gkey (line 839)
no duplicate cntrGkey across all assignments (line 841)
no duplicate projectionGkey across all assignments (line 841)
container and slot must be stow-compatible: identical (lengthBs, stowFactor, weightClass) bucket (line 842: _is_compatible check)
for any twin slot pair both occupied: sum of grossWeightKg <= MAX_TWIN_WEIGHT_KG (default 70000 kg) AND |diff| <= MAX_TWIN_DIFF_KG (default 15000 kg) (lines 849-864)
post_parse_validity_gates: len(solution) >= FULL_LOAD_MINIMUMS[case_name] per case: V1=597, V2=2024, V3=719, V4=1345, V5=577, V6=1621 (line 927) — checked after parsing, not during; causes validity=False but not a parse error
